@41765737357 spent 1.5 hours today helping transport the @120363044028036610@g.us cacao nibs sample to the event that took place today
‎

Had dinner with Bhavana, @41765737357, @41799155602 and @41765663130 last week for 3 hours 

_Key insights_

- it is possible to have *Integrity* (_core value_) without need for Transparency (_not core value_)

_Follow up action_

- future useful insights gathered that are not tokenizable will no longer be shared within these channels (_DM me if you are keen to find out where the category of untokenized  insights are published and shared_)

- ⁠this will further reduce the amount of post within our WhatsApp channels 

- ⁠if two or more DAO members are present, visual submissions will no longer be a requirement to prove that DAO contribution has transpired 

- ⁠Governors retain the right to request for proof when in doubt 

🙂🙏 ‎<This message was edited>
Olaf, @@41765737357, @41765663130⁩ and myself spent 1 hours sharing about Agroverse project to the folks in the Symposium <This message was edited>
Thanks @41765737357 for spending 5 minutes to share this 🙂🙏

I spent 30 minutes this evening with @Karin⁩ walking through the target sales volume we will need to tune our sales and marketing channels for when we load the additional 500kg of cacao almonds from @⁨<guild>[project] Agroverse⁩ AGL7 into our network 



_*The simple math*_
870kg of cacao derivatives to be offloaded via sales over a maximum of 18 months. This means 1.81kg per day

Right now we are offloading an average of 0.33kg per day 

Daily sales volume needs to increase by 5.5X 

Considering I am the only active sales person in the DAO for now, until such a time when the daily sale volume target has been achieved, any request for my personal facetime during office hours needs to be directly tied to driving daily sales volume up otherwise tuned out or redirected to someone else in the DAO 🙂🙏
Thank you @41765737357 for spending 5 minutes to share this
spent 45 minutes exploring with @41765737357 the following
@41765737357 spent 45 minutes giving inputs on how to best package the Buddha bars (40 gram cacao bars) that we will be offering for sale in San Francisco Bay Area via our retail partners
@41765737357 spent 30 minutes giving inputs on custom drinking vessels we could utilize for more elaborate cacao ceremonies during special occasions
Thank you @41765737357 for spending 5 minutes to share this 😊🙏
Thank you @41765737357 for spending 5 minutes to respond

narrative.text: Karin Lanz contributed to TrueSight DAO projects including 20250617_beerhall, Agroverse, MoNYtyze L1 Protocol, and Build Game - Strategy, with primary focus on the 100TDG For every 1 hour of human effort rubric (11 contributions). She participated in Facetime meetings (4), provided reference materials via hyperlinks (3), voted in online polls (2), reviewed and suggested improvements to proposed strategies (2), cautioned against certain actions (2), and contributed a full-scale strategy with rollout action plan (1). Her activity spanned from October 2020 to April 2025.
